description: dbt (data build tool): full refreshes, project operations, and read and check commands. `run`, `build`, `seed`, and `snapshot` build the models of the project in the target warehouse. `run-operation` runs a macro of the project.

rules.note: `--full-refresh` drops incremental models and seeds and builds them again from scratch. Data that the source no longer has is lost.

project_commands.note: `run-operation` runs a macro of the project. The macro can run any SQL, so its effect is not known.

safe.note: Compilation, parsing, listings, documentation, the connection check, packages from `packages.yml`, source freshness, data tests that do not store failures, and the removal of the local `target` folder. They do not write to the warehouse.
